job.meaning: мужчина ~58, седые волосы чуть длиннее, круглые очки в тонкой оправе, тёмно-синяя рубашка, деревянная студия
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a kind experienced Russian man about 58 with slightly longer silver hair swept back, thin round metal glasses, a dark navy linen shirt with the top button open. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium shot from the waist up, he sits relaxed, both shoulders and hands inside the frame, a black podcast microphone on a boom arm at the side of the frame near his chest (never covering the mouth), face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, one hand in a calm open gesture, sincere thoughtful expression, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame from a high-end podcast camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: a podcast studio with warm wooden slat walls and soft amber light, blurred.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
